# Glove80 template default keymap

`glove80.keymap` and `glove80.conf` are MoErgo's default configuration, copied unchanged from
https://github.com/moergo-sc/glove80-zmk-config at commit `34888be8c9d9a3d5b168a502b8b191ba43b4a1f3`
(`config/glove80.keymap`, `config/glove80.conf`). The repository is MIT-licensed; its licence is
`LICENSE` here.

It stands in for a Layout Editor export until BK's real one is available: it has hold-taps, a tap
dance, macros that call behaviours keyloom doesn't model, Bluetooth and RGB bindings and four layers.
